linkedin.headline: Brand designer | Harbour & Pine
linkedin.about: I design identities for independent shops and cafes. Creativity and kindness matter most to me, in work and in life. I paint watercolours to unwind and I need a creative outlet or I get restless. I would like a partner who makes things too and is happy to wander flea markets on a Saturday.
